reason: A better extends prior work by turning suggested high-frequency power modulation into feedback-controlled melt-pool stabilization and testing dimensional, defect, and mechanical outcomes against a fixed-power baseline. B largely repeats the cited ~500 °C thermal-management result from CrNbTiZr L-DED and overgeneralizes it to other HEAs and AM modes, while also attributing porosity and universally improved strength/ductility to preheating without adequate mechanistic support.
